info.title: Social Publisher API
info.description: REST contract for content ingestion, AI variants, campaigns, and social publishing

refreshToken.description: Optional when sent in the httpOnly refresh_token cookie

row.description: Row number in the uploaded file

slug.description: Catalog slug when the platform was recognised

message.description: Operator-facing reason; never contains the secret

browserSessionConfigured.description: True only when an encrypted Playwright storage state is configured; the state itself is never returned.

publishedCount.description: Account list only: posts this account has published that are still live (status PUBLISHED).

credential.description: Write-only credential object. It is encrypted and never returned.

settings.description: Non-secret connector settings to merge into the existing account settings.
Non-secret connector settings to merge. Credentials and encrypted browser session state are left unchanged.

reason.description: Why the account was kept (Vietnamese, shown to the operator)

notFound.description: Ids that do not exist or belong to someone else

ids.description: Accounts to delete (at most 200 per request)

aiRevision.description: Last "rewrite with AI" request: status generating | done | failed, instruction, notes (review points chosen by the operator, when sent), provider and writerLabel of the AI that edits (AI_REVISER, e.g. "Claude Opus"), startedAt, finishedAt, error (also why a lower-scoring edit was not saved).

aiApproval.description: Final AI approver verdict: status running | approved | rejected | failed, approver (provider:model), approverLabel, textHash (the text it read), score, risk, seeding, reasons, startedAt, finishedAt, error. Null when the variant was never sent to the approver.

aiApprovalCurrent.description: True when the stored aiApproval was given on the current title, body and hashtags; false after an edit or when there is none.

aiProvider.description: AI provider for this generation run. Uses the backend default when omitted.

model.description: Model used for this role (the provider default when not set).

configured.description: False when the provider has no key: the reviewer then falls back to the writer, approvals fail.

reviewer.description: Scores every draft and checks seeding and risk for the company (AI_REVIEWER).

approver.description: Final gate on the finished draft (AI_APPROVER).

reviser.description: Writes "Viết lại bằng AI" / "Sửa theo khuyến nghị" (AI_REVISER); the campaign writer when its provider has no key.

approvalEnabled.description: AI_APPROVAL_ENABLED: whether drafts go through the final approver.

platformSlugs.description: Slugs of the platforms chosen in the campaign form.

hint.description: What the operator wants ideas about (optional).
hint.example: proxy dân cư cho người làm affiliate

configured.description: True when VPSTTT AI image generation is configured

community.description: Lemmy / Discuit community or Reddit subreddit (r/name) set on the account.

category.description: Forum category or box set on the account.

title.description: Empty for destinations without a title field (short-form social, Quora).

body.description: Body exactly as the destination receives it; for appearance "rich" it keeps the Markdown the extension turns into HTML.

appearance.description: How to show the body: rendered Markdown, plain paragraphs, or rich text (pasted HTML editor or HTML field).

tags.description: Tags really sent in the destination tag field (for a Chrome extension account: its own tags, then the AI tags the site accepts); empty when hashtags stay in the text.

title.description: Unsaved title to preview instead of the stored one.

body.description: Unsaved body to preview instead of the stored one.

platformAccountId.description: Account of the same platform whose posting route decides the formatting.

prompt.description: New image description; the stored one is reused when omitted, and the AI designs one from the post when there is none.

instruction.description: What to change, in the operator's words; the last review notes are added automatically.

notes.description: Review recommendations the operator chose to apply ("Sửa theo khuyến nghị"). When sent, they replace the automatic review notes: the AI fixes only these.

aiProvider.description: AI provider; the default one when omitted.

sizeBytes.description: Decimal byte count serialized as a string

metadata.description: Media metadata. Uploaded accessible descriptions are returned as altText.

automationErrorDetail.description: Why the last AI run failed: { code, message, platform, platformName, provider, at }.

example.message: VPSTTT AI rate limit was reached. Try again later

reasonLabel.description: Vietnamese explanation shown to the reviewer.

message.description: Vietnamese explanation shown to the reviewer.
Vietnamese reason from the final AI approver gate shown to the reviewer.

activated.description: Whether the campaign was activated for immediate or scheduled delivery.

skippedAccounts.description: Review decisions only: accounts of an approved platform that got no post because they were not ready.

waitingVariantIds.description: Review decisions only: drafts left waiting because their platform had no ready account.

overLimitVariants.description: Review decisions only: drafts left waiting because they exceed their destination character limit.

unapprovedVariants.description: Review decisions only: drafts left waiting because the final AI approver has not approved their current text.

scheduledAt.description: Future ISO-8601 timestamp with an explicit UTC offset. Required for SCHEDULED.
ISO-8601 timestamp with an explicit offset

name.example: Ra mắt sản phẩm VPS mới

brief.description: Thông tin nguồn để AI viết các biến thể riêng cho từng nền tảng.
brief.example: Quảng bá gói VPS hiệu năng cao cho lập trình viên, tập trung vào backup và hỗ trợ 24/7.

mediaAssetIds.description: Previously uploaded, unattached media assets to attach to the generated source content.

generateImages.description: Let VPSTTT AI create one image per destination whose publishing route can attach it. Ignored when mediaAssetIds supplies your own image.

autoPublish.description: Publish each post the AI quality check passed as soon as it (and its image) is ready, without waiting for review. Posts that did not pass still wait for review.

aiProvider.description: AI provider for this automation run. Uses the backend default when omitted.

scheduledAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with Z or an explicit UTC offset.

publishImmediately.description: Activate the generated campaign automatically. A future scheduledAt is still queued for that time.

scheduledAt.description: Future ISO-8601 timestamp with an explicit UTC offset. Required for SCHEDULED.

contentRemoved.description: True when the brief content made for this AI run was deleted with it (library content is kept).

reviewUrl.description: Review queue or platform destination; not an individual post permalink

contentUpdatedAt.description: Timestamp of the current stored variant, not an immutable submission snapshot

footer.description: Company contact footer to print last, after the source line; null on destinations without one

confirmedNotFound.description: Explicit confirmation that the operator checked topics and moderation queues

autoRefresh.description: The system renews this token without the user signing in again

waitingExtension.description: Posts queued for the Chrome extension (not operator work)

devicesOnline.description: Paired Chrome extensions seen in the last 3 minutes

offline.description: Posts are waiting but no Chrome extension is running

total.description: Items an operator should act on

enabled.description: true: publish through the paired Chrome extension

autoSubmit.description: false: fill the form and wait for the operator to click Post

inArticle.description: Inside a post, comment or feed item

selector.description: Unique CSS path of the element in its document or shadow root

url.description: Current page URL; must be on the task destination
Current page URL; must be on the account sign-in origins

invalid.description: The page marks the control invalid (aria-invalid, :invalid)

selected.description: Label of the option currently chosen

selector.description: Unique CSS path of the control in its document or shadow root

url.description: Current page URL; must be on the task destination

excludeOrigins.description: Origins already running a flow in this Chrome

url.description: Thread URL once the post exists

message.description: Short text shown to the operator (forum error banner, etc.)

detectedUsername.description: Username the sign-in check found in Chrome (account mismatch); kept in the attempt details only

googleBlocked.description: Google asked for a verification the extension cannot complete; kept in the attempt details only

deviceId.description: Paired Chrome that signs in and posts for this account.

loginUsername.description: Email or username used to sign in.

password.description: Password of the platform, or of the Google account for Google sign-in.

expectedUsername.description: Handle on the platform; found after the first login when omitted.

profileUrl.description: Own profile page on the platform.

targetUrl.description: New-post page; the flow default is used when omitted.

category.description: Forum category or community, when the flow needs one.
